nodes.label: Divide number-line segments
nodes.description: Calculate the distance between two points on a number line and the coordinate of the point dividing a segment internally or externally in a given ratio, including the mid-point.

nodes.label: Quadrants and reflections
nodes.description: Determine the quadrant of a point and find the coordinates of its symmetric points with respect to the x−axis, the y−axis and the origin.

nodes.label: Distance and equidistant points
nodes.description: Calculate the distance between two points on the coordinate plane, find an unknown coordinate from a given distance, and determine the coordinates of a point equidistant from two points.

nodes.label: Division points, centroid and symmetric points
nodes.description: Calculate the coordinates of internal and external division points, the mid-point and the centroid of a triangle on the coordinate plane, and determine the point symmetric to a given point with respect to another point using the mid-point.

nodes.label: Classify triangles from coordinates
nodes.description: Determine whether a triangle with given vertices is equilateral, isosceles, right-angled or isosceles right-angled by calculating (AB)^2, (BC)^2 and (CA)^2.

nodes.label: Find equations of straight lines
nodes.description: Find the equation of a straight line through a point with a given gradient, through two points, or parallel to an axis, and use it to find a constant making three points collinear or a line pass through an intersection point.

nodes.label: Parallel, perpendicular, symmetric
nodes.description: Use gradients to identify parallel and perpendicular lines, find lines through a point parallel or perpendicular to a given line, and determine perpendicular bisectors and symmetric points.

nodes.label: Distance and triangle area
nodes.description: Calculate the distance from a point to a line using the formula, and use it to find the length of a perpendicular and the area of a triangle from its vertices.

nodes.label: Fixed points; no triangle
nodes.description: Determine the fixed point of a line through all values of k, and find the constant for which three lines do not form a triangle.

nodes.label: Equation of a circle
nodes.description: Determine the equation of a circle from its center and radius, a point on it, the ends of a diameter, three points, tangency to the axes or a center on a line; identify a figure from its equation and find the values of k for which an equation represents a circle.

nodes.label: Circle and line intersections
nodes.description: Calculate the points of intersection of a circle and a line, determine their number using the discriminant D, find constants or radii for tangency, and compute the length of a chord.

nodes.label: Tangents to a circle
nodes.description: Derive the equation of a tangent to a circle x²+y²=r², at a given point on it or drawn from a point not on it.

nodes.label: Two circles: positions and intersections
nodes.description: Determine the positional relationship between two circles using r, r' and d, find the equation of a circle that touches a given circle, and find the points of intersection of two circles, the line through them, and a circle passing through those points and another point.
